reviews.summary: German digital agency says it ran a 10-task prompt set, including an anime/game asset task, but publishes no per-task results. Calls Midjourney the benchmark for aesthetics and style consistency, and weakest of the leaders on text.

vendorClaims.text: V8.1 renders standard jobs roughly 4-5x faster than earlier versions, with native 2K output (reported by third-party write-ups of Midjourney's announcement).

strengths: default aesthetic and style exploration for concept art (consensus of desk reviews)
consistent visual style across a set
weaknesses: weaker prompt adherence and in-image text than the API leaders
no official public API; no free plan
Trustpilot dominated by billing and cancellation complaints

reviews.summary: Strong prompt fidelity and text; less expressive aesthetics than Midjourney.

vendorClaims.text: Images 2.5 (2026-09-08) claims up to 50% lower latency than Images 2.0, with better lighting, textures and subject preservation; it adds Sketch, Templates and comment-based edits (as reported by press).

strengths: tops both Artificial Analysis image boards (generation and editing)
weaknesses: sprite sheets and true low-colour pixel art still weak (HN users)
'sameness' / recognisable house style; less expressive than Midjourney

bench.detail: Elo: Lucid Origin Ultra (Leonardo's own model, Aug 2025) #89 of 106

strengths: cheap entry with a free daily allowance
many models in one place (own Lucid/Phoenix plus third-party)
weaknesses: Leonardo's own models rank in the bottom fifth of both arenas
style less consistent than custom-trained tools

vendorClaims.text: Recommends Flux 2, Z-Image or Qwen Image as custom-training bases; any generated output can be used to train a custom model in one click.
Customer Tripledot says Layer tripled its production speed (customer quote on Layer's own site).

reviews.summary: Tested an 8-frame top-down walk cycle and a 4-direction set. The first six frames held shape and palette; frames 7-8 drifted (belt shift, shadow flicker), fixable quickly in Aseprite. Judged a head start, not final art.

vendorClaims.text: Generates 4/8-direction rotations, skeleton- and text-driven animations, tilesets, maps and UI elements; offers an Aseprite extension, a Pixelorama-based editor and an API.

strengths: holds shape and palette across most frames (Techsy test)
weaknesses: animation drifts in later frames; needs a human cleanup pass

vendorClaims.text: Models trained with experienced pixel artists for grid-aligned, limited-palette output; also distributed via Replicate, Poe and Scenario.
Sprite Generator turns one sprite into an animation set with pose, sequence and transition tools; 30+ art styles; exports for Unity, Godot, Unreal and GameMaker.

notes: Missing tools to consider: Google Nano Banana (Gemini image models, in Gemini app / AI Studio), Recraft, Adobe Firefly, Krea, Ideogram, FLUX.2 / ComfyUI (local, open weights), Sprite AI / Sprixen (pixel-art sprite generators)
